segments.name: Uranium royalties
products: debt and equity investments in uranium companies
segments.description: Acquires and manages uranium and critical minerals royalty interests, streams and physical uranium, earning revenue from project production and inventory sales.
segments.evidence: The Company conducts its business as a single operating segment, being the acquiring and assembling a portfolio of royalties, investing in companies with exposure to uranium and physical uranium.

revenueModel.text: Project operators pay royalties on production, third-party buyers pay for physical uranium inventory, and operators pay lease and rental amounts for land and mineral interests.
revenueModel.evidence: Additionally, we generate revenue from the buying and selling of physical uranium inventory, generate lease bonus revenue by leasing certain mineral interests to third-party operators, earn surface revenue from surface use leases and easement payments and earn annual rental revenue from land rental payments.
